evidence: Workbook quality row 18 requires the reference to plausibly satisfy every scored criterion; the frozen skill quality-checks.md check 18 defines a reference-failing criterion as P0. Functional judge.toml describes cw_js_format_semantics_and_undo and cw_html_format_semantics_and_undo: format twice, then one Undo returns exact original. In frozen solution/app/src/custom-editor.js:72-88, formatDocument compares raw Prettier result with current source at line 80, pushes an Undo at line 81, but stores result with its trailing newline removed at line 83. Direct read-only Node/Prettier 3.6.2 reproduction on both JS and HTML shows first stored format has no final newline; formatting it again returns identical text plus final newline (raw comparison false, stored comparison true). Thus the second Format pushes a redundant Undo snapshot, and one Undo restores the already-formatted text rather than the original. Frozen served public/assets/index-Cx_0Zwwi.js contains the same compare/push/strip sequence, so this affects the shipped reference. Snapshot source hash 686375a3fd9b6c8953220616c491cb348aeaaa3498820667cab7d14cb0fcee10 matches manifest input hash for that file; assignment input SHA256 988cc513c1ccda1eec9563f88f73b3d673b5a7679727d55c68a85c2e7ca7985e matches manifest. raw-evidence-index.json is absent; no full browser judge or Oracle grade was observed.
counterexample: Paste function f(){return 1} as a new .js draft, press Format document twice, then Undo once. The source remains formatted instead of returning to the exact one-line original. The same sequence occurs with compact complete HTML. These are explicit full-credit steps in two functional criteria.
suggested_fix: Normalize Prettier output before comparing it with the current source and return without pushUndo when the normalized text is unchanged; rebuild the shipped public asset and verify both format-twice/one-Undo paths in the browser.
